independent_profile_comparison.limitation: Numeric control/timing differences do not prove perceptual distinction. The 36-profile baseline is intentionally separate from the current 39-profile integration.

static_native_receipt.scope: Eight Puzzled anchors with actual anchored-inner-brow, uneven upper-lash and asymmetric sealed-purse geometry checks. State and geometry do not establish native visual fidelity, normal-speed observation or approval.

mp4_order_checks.method: All decoded frames compared with same-index full/detail native panels and all-frame nearest-face errors; identical and near-identical holds remain ambiguous under lossy encoding.
